name: College of Spirits
summary: Storytellers who channel spirits through tales told from beyond.

features.name: Guiding Whispers
features.summary: You learn the Guidance cantrip, which doesn't count against your cantrips known. For you it has a range of 60 ft.

features.name: Spiritual Focus
features.short: Use a candle, crystal ball or similar as a focus; +1d6 later.
features.summary: You can use a candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board or tarokka deck as a spellcasting focus. From 6th level, when you cast a bard spell that deals damage or restores hit points through it, roll a d6 and add it to one roll.

features.name: Tales from Beyond
features.short: Spend inspiration to draw a random spirit tale.
features.summary: As a bonus action, expend a Bardic Inspiration and roll your die on the Spirit Tales table. You can tell the tale (an action) to a creature within 30 ft., producing effects like damage, healing, teleporting or frightening.

features.name: Spirit Session
features.short: A ritual with allies teaches you a temporary divination or necromancy spell.
features.summary: During a 1-hour ritual with willing creatures, you temporarily learn one divination or necromancy spell of a level up to the number of participants, which counts as a bard spell until your next long rest.

features.name: Mystical Connection
features.short: Roll twice on the Spirit Tales table and choose.
features.summary: Whenever you roll on the Spirit Tales table, you can roll the die twice and choose which result to use.
